title: Zoom Build platform API key in an x-api-key header
summary: A synthetic Build platform API key after an x-api-key header in a raw request, a curl option and a JSON header map.
rationale: Zoom documents the x-api-key header as carrying the Build platform API key, and it is the only documented carrier that is API-key-only: the Authorization Bearer header carries either an API key or a JWT and is not covered. The page states no prefix, alphabet or length, so the header name is the only identifying context and no bare-value rule is implied. The key is shown once at creation and the page says raw API keys must never be embedded in client-side code. The key ID shown for internal support is a different value, and the JWT generated from the key and secret is a different credential.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#244). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: the value of an x-api-key header on a Build platform request is treated as a credential. Zoom documents the header and the API key (carrier existence only); the value admission and extent are the project's decisions.
